Who publishes the most science? Science and engineering articles per year by country, 2002–2023 (joint papers split between the authors' countries).
In 2002 the USA published 28% of the world's articles and China 6%. China passed the USA in 2017; in 2023 it had 28%, the USA 13%. India rose from 12th to 3rd.
Source: US National Science Foundation, Science and Engineering Indicators 2026 (Scopus data)
